solves.reasoning: 원문: space inseparable from what defines it / central to the heart / must accept → inseparable—central—accept
원문: physical space / spatial framework / context exterior to experience → physical—spatial—exterior
원문: as commonly supposed / beings surround themselves / would be only abstractions → commonly—surround—abstractions
공간은 경험의 외부(exterior) 배경으로 여겨짐 → ④ interior 부적절
경험은 물리적(physical) 공간에서 일어남 → ① mental 부적절
공간이 경험 핵심에 중심적(central)이어야 결론 성립 → ② marginal 부적절
experiences take place in a ___ space → 물리적 공간 → physical
spatial framework is the ___ of all experiences → 매개체 → medium
Beings ___ themselves with the places → 둘러쌈 → surround
made the point elegantly(우아하게) ≈ gracefully; clumsily는 반의어
as commonly supposed(흔히) ≈ usually; rarely/seldom은 반대
accept the possibility(받아들이다) ≈ admit; reject/deny는 반대
central(중심적) ↔ minor(사소한); essential은 유의어 함정
accept(수용) ↔ reject(거부); approve는 유의어 함정
made the point = 요점/주장 → 'made an important point during the lecture'
a piece of clothing worn on the body = garment(의복)
accept the ___ that ~ : 관사 the 뒤·목적어 → 명사 possible→possibility
a disguise and a ___ : 관사 a 뒤·병렬 → 명사 characterize→characterization
If place and space are ___, framework is medium → 경험 핵심에 중심적 → central to the very heart of experience
makes the space ___, from the event → 그 사건과 분리불가 → inseparable from what defines it
